reviews.t: Great Hair Paste for Men with Thinning Hair
reviews.x: When I travel, I need to carry hair product that I can fit into a small container for those tiny plastic bags that I need to carry-on.  Because this paste is thick, it allows me to transfer it very easy and it travels well. Now, let's talk about the product itself.  I started using the product about three months ago. I use it every day and really like the scent.  Very tropical!  I dont have a lot of hair to work with and a little goes a long way.  The product works as advertised and it makes my

Really good styling paste and it smells pretty good too. Not very greasy or sticky at all. Washes out easy and does not flake. My hair looks shiny and healthy. I used to use a glue in my hair that was too stiff and flaky. I'm glad I made the switch to the Argan & Coconut oil based paste.

I absolutely love this product! I have tried several different types of texture pastes, but....they all went in the garbage after trying to like them. I got my hair cut pretty short in Late 2014. I just happened to run across this product while shopping on Amazon and thought I would give it a try. I opened the jar and first noticed the soft mild scent. The reviews of this product caught my attention for this product and I was skeptical not being familiar with the brand before, though am happy I purchased it. My brother and I have different types of hairs so we both tried it out. I don't even know how to describe his hairstyle but most of it is shaved and he has a section of long hair that he usually slicks back. Right now he uses a styling creme and hair spray so I had his try this. It's a paste so it is a thicker consistency than cream. A little bit goes a long way. This texture paste is a medium hold paste that makes your hair softer in the process of giving it a messy look or whatever else you may be going for with the paste. My son' has thick, curly/wavy hair that can be dry. To counter that we use this texture paste and it has made his hair softer. This container is small and looks nice on the counter plus the container makes it easy to access just the amount you want. This does not have any overpowering scent which is nice

reviews.t: Great product for a hair styling idiot!
reviews.x: I was so glad I tried this! I impulsively cut my hair into a pixie, and ended up with a disaster. I needed styling products, but I didn't have anything in my arsenal of beauty products. This is light-it didn't leave my hair stiff, but it controls and keeps it in place. I'm kind of obsessed with Coconut Oil, which is one of the ingredients, and this paste leaves my hair soft. It also smells amazing!

reviews.t: It was great for my hair
reviews.x: It was great for my hair, and the smell was also a plus. This was my first time trying a paste, and I got interested in the product because I'm a person that's always willing to try new things, and it paid off

reviews.t: This is a really great product for supplying a decent hold without making the ...
reviews.x: This is a really great product for supplying a decent hold without making the hair stiff. It keeps my hair in place without looking greasy, it basically just looks natural. It doesn't make my hair heavy or gross feeling later in the day either. It basically disappears but still works.
LOVE IT! I can't wait to receive my next jar. THANK YOU!

Initially, I loved that it is made with Argan oil which is perfect for my natural hair. Whenever I wear a high puff or a Mohawk, this cream makes my hair look so sleek compared to when I just used daily moisturizer. I've been using this product for over s month now and I will continue.
Smells great and the hold/shine was perfect.

I've used this cool product twice and I wish someone had been here to take photos of my hair because I can’t get selfies right to save my soul. I'm still amazed by the results. I didn’t go all out and wild with my hair style but I did give my hair body and curl. I was afraid my hair would be stiff but that wasn’t the case. Great product, you only need a small amount so it lasts a long time. Hold is good I just wish it came in a stronger hold. Very natural look and feel to your hair. No flakes or stiffness. Overall great hair product.

reviews.t: One of the best products you can get to make your hair stay ...
reviews.x: One of the best products you can get to make your hair stay in place, but still want to be able to play around with it throughout the day. No hardness or oily residue.
It's quality is also very good compare with its price.

I was very excited to try this product. It has a somewhat sticky texture when applying, and doesn't spread easily until you apply heat- I use a blow drying curling iron to smooth and shape my unruly curly hair. This paste smells delicious, and once heat is applied it spreads and coats the hair smoothly and evenly. It's not heavy or greasy and helps hold my hair in the curls and shapes I create for several hours.

This is a great product comparable to most hair pastes (e.g., American Crew), Its very light and has a pleasant, but not overwhelming scent. The package arrived quickly, the product is a good price, and works wonderful!
This is a wonderful product. It smells great and gives my hair soft hold.

reviews.t: Works well, but strong perfume smell
reviews.x: This product DOES WORK very well...but the perfume smell was too strong for me and I had to return it after one use. I had hoped the smell would dissipate after some hours, but I had to wash it out. If you aren't particularly sensitive to smells, I would recommend this. It works well without being stiff. I would have kept it for sure.

reviews.t: I have extremely fine hair and lots of flyaways
reviews.x: I have extremely fine hair and lots of flyaways. This stuff hold is together and makes my hair easier to style. Just doing braids on my hair is a challenge since it's so stringy. But this stuff makes it easy and smells amazingggg.
Not only does it make you look good,  it smells great!! Plus ingredients promote hair health?? Exactly what I was looking for. Will be buying again.

reviews.t: Must Try, nice product that actually works
reviews.x: This is a very nice hair setting gel that is not too greasy yet does the job right. Liked it and will order again. Highly recommended.

This smells great, I don't have to use very much and it leaves my hair soft and frizz free.  It also doesn't leave my hair feeling sticky or crispy like mousse or hair spray. I've had it a little less than a month and used it on my hair when it was medium long, and recently got it cut pretty short, helps both lengths. claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for providing good hold without leaving hair stiff, sticky, or greasy.
Many reviewers say only a small amount is needed, making the product long-lasting.
Several reviewers mention the pleasant smell as a plus.
Some reviewers note it leaves hair soft, shiny, and natural-looking with no flakes.
A few reviewers report the product feels like glue or is too stiff, particularly on fine or thin hair.
